name: Sushi Masuda

menus.name: Omakase counter
menus.note: About 20 courses: four or five appetisers, 10 to 12 pieces of sushi and soup, at a six-seat counter.

bookingOpens: Online on Tock. A whole month's tables open on the 1st of the month before at 5pm Vancouver time (bookings for February open on 1 January). A deposit is taken when booking and returned to the card on arrival. Dinner is served Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday from 5:30pm and Friday from 7pm; closed Monday and Tuesday.
cancellation: Cancel at least seven days before the booking for the deposit back; after that it is kept. Guests more than 20 minutes late may lose the table and the deposit.
groups: Tock takes parties of one to six.
dressCode: No dress code is stated, but guests are asked not to wear perfume, cologne or other strong scents.
children: The course is for guests aged 13 and over, and there is no children's menu.
